system.name: MCU (Minecraft Universe)
system.one_liner: An evaluation framework in Minecraft with 3,452 composable atomic tasks, LLM-generated task configs and a VLM-based evaluator for open-ended game agents.

content.variant_note: five lettered tiles of unequal size: a pipeline, a data-source-to-taxonomy panel and three small result charts
content.argues: MCU offers diverse verified tasks and a cheap VLM-based evaluator for open-ended Minecraft agents, and exposes weaknesses of SOTA agents in creativity, error recognition and harder task variants.
content.subject: Composite overview of the MCU benchmark: pipeline, task sources and taxonomy, and three result charts.

lessons.what_to_learn: Compose a benchmark overview as lettered bands: the pipeline with real text samples on stacked cards on top, a central taxonomy chart bracketed between its data sources and the real-world meaning of its categories, and a strip of small result charts that each back one claim. A cross and tick on loop arrows shows verify-and-refine without extra boxes.
lessons.suits: Benchmark or evaluation-framework papers that must show construction, coverage and headline results in a single figure.

evidence: MCU includes two main components: task generation and trajectory evaluation.
The atomic task set is sourced from the Minecraft wiki, in-game data, existing benchmarks, and brainstorming sessions.
The automatic evaluation (AutoEval) of MCU is 8.1× more cost-effective and 4.8× more efficient in labeling 30 samples.

summary: MCU (Minecraft Universe) is an evaluation framework for open-ended game agents. Figure 1 is a five-panel composite. Panel a draws the benchmarking pipeline: atomic task lists feed an LLM-based task config generator, shown as a stack of cards holding a real config, whose commands are checked in MineStudio with a refine loop (red cross) and a new-tasks path (green tick) to a set of agents (VPT, STEVE-1, GROOT, MineDojo); their trajectory videos go to a VLM-based evaluator. Panel b brackets four data-source cards into a two-ring sunburst of task categories beside a list of real-world challenges. Panels c to e are small charts: a radar of agents over six capabilities, bars of task progress by difficulty, and human versus automatic cost and time.
summary_zh: MCU 是面向开放式游戏智能体的评测框架。图 1 含五个面板：a 为评测流程（任务配置生成、MineStudio 校验、智能体、VLM 评估），b 为数据来源与任务类别旭日图，c 到 e 为雷达图、难度柱图和人机评测成本对比。
notes: Kinds follow the prior pass but the variant is bento-highlights (the prior's benchmark-dashboard is a scope-overview variant and fits panel b). The digest's text strings for panels b to e are garbled (unmapped glyphs), so labels and chart values were read from the picture. Colour roles of #445936 and the other greens are inferred. The charts c to e probably come as one wide raster (a 3180x780 px bitmap is placed at the bottom), which is inferred from the bitmap sizes in the SVG.
